meta.title: Cookie policy — Mario Álvarez
meta.description: Which cookies marioalvarez.me uses, which ones need your permission and how to change your choice at any time.
meta.heading: Cookie policy
meta.eleccionTexto: You can change it or delete your data at any time, as easily as you gave it.

secciones.titulo: 1. What they are and whether I need your permission

bloques.texto: Cookies and similar technologies (such as the browser's local storage) store small pieces of data on your device. Under article 22.2 of the Spanish LSSI-CE and the Spanish Data Protection Agency's guide on cookies, those strictly necessary for something you request do not require consent; analytics cookies do.

That is why this website only stores the analytics cookie if you accept it, and lets you accept or reject with two equal buttons, on the same screen and with no pre-ticked boxes. Rejecting it does not stop you from using any part of the website.

filas: Storing your choice, the version of this policy and the pseudonymous identifier of your consent record
Pseudonymous identifier to learn which content is useful
Remembering whether you prefer the light or dark theme; only stored if you change it

bloques.texto: There are no third-party cookies, no advertising, no embedded social media content and no Google Analytics. Typefaces and images are served from this same website.

You can change your choice or withdraw consent at any time from "Cookie settings" in the footer of every page, or with the button on this page. From there you can also instantly delete the analytics data linked to your browser. You can also delete cookies in your browser settings.

Each time you accept, reject or withdraw consent a record is kept (pseudonymous identifier, decision, version of this policy, date and time, page, language, source and browser), without your IP address, to be able to show that consent was valid. It is kept for 3 years. More details in the privacy policy.
If this policy changes significantly, the cookie notice will appear again so you can decide anew.
